name: web-features-section-with-circled-word-and-phone-carousel-tile
title: Features Section with Circled Word and Phone Carousel
whatItIs: A cropped landing page section with a boarding pass tile at the top, a centred headline 'Everything you Need. One Journey, One Place.' with the last words circled by a hand-drawn ellipse, four feature cards with black icon tiles and Learn More links around a central blue tile of three phones, an Explore all Features pill and a next heading with another circled word.
whatItMeans: Icon cards around a centre product tile is a clear layout for feature lists, and the circled words repeat a friendly signature.
techniques: Four feature cards around one central product panel
Blue gradient pill CTA under the grid
Section heading repeated with the same circling device

vocabulary.definition: A product visual placed between feature cards.
A rounded square holding an icon.
A small text link with an arrow at a card's base.
